arch-provenance-header.pass: Each rule carries Rule, Reason, Set by, Source, Revisit when and Regeneration test in a @fitness KDoc.
arch-provenance-header.fail: Each rule needs a Rule, a Reason and a Source link, nothing more.

arch-flagged-rule.pass: Don't enforce it. Draft it @Disabled("no provenance: ...") in a separate flagged constraints file and mark it flagged: no reason.
arch-flagged-rule.fail: Enforce it anyway since the structure is consistent; invent a plausible reason.

arch-mutation-check.pass: The mutation must be the failure the rule's `Reason` names, not just any forbidden dependency. If it already fails, report it as a finding and do not weaken the rule.
arch-mutation-check.fail: Add any forbidden import and confirm it fails; if the rule fails today, adjust it until it passes.
